overall_rationale: Two must needs are unmet: N2 (product-code mapping across the 2024 change; no mapping table exists) and N3 (daily maximum temperature; the only candidate's free API is non-commercial and blocks this production use). N1 is only partially met, so the must-need core is incomplete. The should needs N4 (holidays, licence unknown) and N5 (events, met with conditions) do not change the outcome. Resolving N3 would need a Legal decision on a paid subscription, and no catalog source can supply the N2 mapping.
